title: The US-R1-001 bullet cites `scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt sections 4-5` as it…
description:
The US-R1-001 bullet cites `scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt sections 4-5` as its evidence pointer, but that file is ephemeral and gitignored (.gitignore:81) and is overwritten by every subsequent review round; it is not tracked on main. patterns.md is by contract durable and versioned on main, so this cross-reference is unresolvable for any future reader. The bullet already states the measured facts inline ('measured: two criteria in US-001's own acceptanceCriteria, patterns.md keyword-density and CLAUDE.md placement, both did this against unmodified main'), so the citation is supplementary rather than load-bearing. Consider dropping the pointer or replacing it with the CAM issue number, which is durable.

Source: cam/issue-372
Review round: 2
